reason: Report B23. The Messages extension links FernletExchange alone (MessagesExtensionBoundaryTests), so FernletFeedback is out of reach; this one file holds the extension's three feels, each copied from FernletFeedback's table. This one is `tick`'s selection tick, played only when the person picks a different recipe or workout card, whose moss outline is its visual twin. UIKit's generator plays nothing when the system Sounds & Haptics switch is off; the app-wide All / Fewer / Off level lives in the app's own defaults, which this process cannot read. Haptic only, never a sound.
